tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the AgentSearch index for AI agents and MCP servers matching a natural-language query. Ranked by final_score = query_fit × agent_quality.

query.description: Natural-language description of what the agent should do.

tools.name: agent_details
tools.description: Get the full scored profile for one indexed agent (by exact name). Returns inventory data, layer scores (Fame / Usability / Functionality / Call Graph), reasoning, and live blocker status.

tools.name: found_agent
tools.description: Live-score an arbitrary agent URL (crawl + probe + LLM-score using the same rubric the batch pipeline uses). Works for agents not yet in the index.

tools.name: browse
tools.description: Paginated list of every indexed agent, ranked by overall quality.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Index-level statistics: totals, source/license breakdown, capability cluster rollups, stars / recency / speed distributions, agent call graph summary.
